headline: BNP authorizes Tarique Rahman to finalize presidential candidate
summary: The party's standing committee has delegated the responsibility of nominating the candidate for the presidency to the BNP chairman.
details: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has officially authorized its chairman, Tarique Rahman, to finalize the selection of the party's candidate for the presidency.
This decision was made by the BNP's standing committee during a recent meeting, delegating the key responsibility of nomination to the party head.
The move ensures that the party's top leadership has the final say in who will represent the BNP in the upcoming presidential contest.
The Home Minister also confirmed that the decision on who the presidential candidate will be rests with Tarique Rahman.
caption:
Who will be the BNP's presidential candidate? The party has now put the final decision in the hands of Tarique Rahman.

The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has officially authorized its chairman, Tarique Rahman, to finalize the selection of the party's candidate for the presidency.

This decision was made by the BNP's standing committee during a recent meeting, delegating the key responsibility of nomination to the party head.

The move ensures that the party's top leadership has the final say in who will represent the BNP in the upcoming presidential contest.

The Home Minister also confirmed that the decision on who the presidential candidate will be rests with Tarique Rahman.

headline_marked: Police HQ issues [[nationwide alert over possible attacks]] on police vehicles
headline: Police HQ issues nationwide alert over possible attacks on police vehicles
summary: Intelligence suggests extremist groups or miscreants may target jeeps, pickup trucks, and buses; security measures have been strengthened across the country.
details: Police Headquarters has issued a nationwide alert warning of possible attacks on police vehicles by extremist groups or other miscreants.
The urgent directive, issued on Saturday, instructs all police units to strengthen security measures to prevent such incidents.
Intelligence reports indicate that police jeeps, pickup trucks, and buses could be targeted by these groups.
Police vehicles temporarily halted during duty must be parked in secure locations and kept under constant surveillance, as per the directive.
The directive also emphasizes that vehicles must not be left unattended and security must be enhanced for those parked in police stations and office compounds.
Additional IGP (crime and operations) Khondker Rafiqul Islam described the move as a precautionary measure due to potential programs by banned organizations in August.
Police Headquarters has labeled the matter as 'highly important' and urged all concerned to implement the instructions with utmost priority.
caption:
Police vehicles nationwide are on high alert after intelligence suggests they could be targeted by extremist groups.

Police Headquarters has issued a nationwide alert warning of possible attacks on police vehicles by extremist groups or other miscreants.

The urgent directive, issued on Saturday, instructs all police units to strengthen security measures to prevent such incidents.

Intelligence reports indicate that police jeeps, pickup trucks, and buses could be targeted by these groups.

Police vehicles temporarily halted during duty must be parked in secure locations and kept under constant surveillance, as per the directive.

The directive also emphasizes that vehicles must not be left unattended and security must be enhanced for those parked in police stations and office compounds.

Additional IGP (crime and operations) Khondker Rafiqul Islam described the move as a precautionary measure due to potential programs by banned organizations in August.

Police Headquarters has labeled the matter as 'highly important' and urged all concerned to implement the instructions with utmost priority.
